_note: Study-habits profile, not a learning-styles quiz. Each answer changes app behavior (see 'effects').

questions.q: Which test are you prepping for?
questions.effects: sets the toggle default; 'both' keeps both banks active

questions.q: When is your test? (skip if you don't know yet)
questions.effects: drives the spacing schedule and days-to-test on the dashboard

questions.q: On a normal school day, how many minutes can you really give this?
Where will you mostly do this?
questions.effects: phone turns on bigger tap targets everywhere

questions.q: When you miss a question, what do you want to see first?
options: A hint, then let me retry

questions.q: Do you learn a new idea better by hearing it explained or reading it?
questions.effects: hear puts the podcast first in the dashboard Next up list, read puts the strategies first; a preference, not a learning style

questions.q: ACT only: are you taking the optional Science section?
questions.effects: shows or hides Science everywhere; 'unsure' shows it
dashboard puts that section first and the planner front-loads it

questions.q: Last practice or real score, if you have one (optional)
questions.effects: shown as the starting score in the dashboard Estimated band card

questions.q: On timed tests, do you run out of time?
questions.effects: pacing coach intensity: never → off, sometimes → checkpoints, always → checkpoints plus per-question nudge
